name: Due diligence: title, planning history, topographic and desk-study surveys
delay_risk: Ground or title issues can kill the deal

name: Pre-application advice meetings with the council
delay_risk: Council slots can take weeks to book

name: Conditional exchange on land, subject to planning
Appoint design team (architect, structural, MEP, planning consultant, QS)
Concept design and outline cost plan
Spatial coordination: coordinated architecture, structure, services
Planning reports: daylight, transport, ecology, energy, flood, noise, fire statement
delay_risk: Ecology surveys are seasonal (bats, nesting birds)

name: Consultation (21 days) and determination to committee resolution
delay_risk: Statutory 13 weeks for major schemes, often much longer

name: Negotiate and sign Section 106, decision notice issued
Judicial review challenge window (6 weeks)
delay_risk: Lenders often wait for this to close

name: Building regulations full plans approval
delay_risk: Higher-risk buildings need Gateway 2 instead (12 weeks statutory)

name: Tender to main contractors (design and build)
Evaluate tenders and award main contract
Construction finance agreed and first drawdown
Contractor mobilisation and subcontract packages let
delay_risk: Key trades may be booked elsewhere

name: Party wall notices and awards with neighbours
Apply for new utility connections (power, water, telecoms)
Pre-demolition asbestos and structural surveys
delay_risk: Survey may find more asbestos than expected

name: Soft strip of fixtures and fittings
Crush, sort and clear rubble, grub out old foundations
Ground investigation boreholes and any contamination remediation
RC frame: level 1 columns, core and slab
delay_risk: Target cycle 7 to 8 days per floor

name: Strike props and back-propping
delay_risk: Props stay until slabs gain strength

name: Roof waterproofing (single-ply membrane)
delay_risk: Membranes cannot be laid in rain

name: Brick-slip or rainscreen cladding, lower floors
Blockwork party walls and cores, lower floors
MEP first fix (pipes, cables, ducts), lower floors
Drylining, plastering and screed, lower floors
delay_risk: Screed and plaster need drying time

name: Drylining, plastering and screed, upper floors
Kitchens, bathrooms, doors and joinery, lower floors
Kitchens, bathrooms, doors and joinery, upper floors
MEP second fix (sockets, taps, heat pumps), lower floors
Test and commission fire alarm, smoke vents, ventilation, electrics
Practical completion and handover to developer
